title: Product Market Research Analyst - International IT Products
description:
Job Summary We are seeking a Product Market Research Analyst who can spot the next big opportunity in global IT markets. You'll study how technology products are evolving across regions, track global competitors and startups, and provide actionable insights to guide our international product strategy and innovation roadmap. This role suits someone who enjoys turning complex market data into clear stories and briefing top management with concise insights every day. About the Role Youll act as the eyes and ears of our company in the global tech world. Your job is to research whats happening across SaaS, AI, cloud, fintech, and cybersecurity markets identify new ideas, track innovative startups, and summarize insights that guide our product roadmap. Youll work closely with Product Managers and Strategy teams to help answer questions like: What new IT products are trending globally? What customer problems are startups solving in each region? Which features and pricing models are winning internationally? Key Responsibilities Research global IT product trends and emerging startups across the US, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Track competitor products , launches, pricing, and go-to-market strategies. Prepare daily/weekly reports summarizing market news, innovations, and opportunities. Conduct online research using tools like Crunchbase, ProductHunt, Statista, or LinkedIn. Support Product Managers with insights that shape new product concepts. Collect and analyze customer feedback, surveys, or industry data to identify unmet needs. Maintain a dashboard or tracker of ongoing market movements and potential product ideas. Present findings in clear, simple formats - slides, short reports, or infographics. If you are excited about this role please share your updated resume and contact details to discuss further or contact us.

title: Manager - Financial Planning and Ananlysis
description:
Job Title: Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis Location: Noida Job Summary As Finance Manager, you will serve as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, driving financial planning, commercial decision support, and business performance across Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and corporate functions. The role combines FPA, commercial finance, business partnering, and financial analysis, requiring strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to translate complex financial insights into actionable business outcomes. This is a high-visibility role offering the opportunity to influence growth strategy, evaluate new products and business initiatives, and lead finance transformation efforts while partnering closely with the CFO, Managing Director, and cross-functional leaders to drive profitability and sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Finance Lead the annual and quarterly planning processes, working closely with functional and business leaders, demonstrating strong stakeholder management, strategic mindset, and effective communication skills. Partner with functional heads to understand the key business drivers behind financial performance, leveraging business insights, consulting skills, and financial acumen. Analyse historical performance and develop forward-looking insights to support management decisions, utilizing data analytics, quantitative skills, and a strategic mindset. Own monthly financial reviews and provide insightful analysis of actuals vs. plan, trends, risks, and opportunities through strong financial acumen, business insights, and data analytics capabilities. Prepare high-quality financial analysis and management information for the CFO, MD, and senior leadership team, communicating complex financial matters effectively through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and stakeholder management. Support strategic and ad hoc business analysis as required, applying business insights, financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a global perspective where relevant. Commercial Finance Revenue Planning Lead the planning process for annual and quarterly revenue/sales plans in partnership with the National Sales Head, CFO, and MD, balancing stakeholder expectations while applying financial modelling, strategic mindset, and financial acumen. Understand sales trends, market dynamics, product performance, and commercial drivers through strong business insights, data analytics, and a global perspective. Provide financial insights to help leadership identify growth opportunities and emerging risks, utilizing financial acumen, strategic thinking, and consulting skills. Analyse profitability and margins across products, customers, and business segments using financial modelling, data analytics, and quantitative skills. Support management in making data-driven commercial decisions through robust financial analysis, business insights, consulting skills, and effective stakeholder engagement. Finance Partner to the Publishing Business This is where the role gets particularly interesting. Work closely with the Publishing and Editorial teams to: Lead the annual planning process for Publishing Plans and Editorial Budgets, applying financial acumen, stakeholder management, and a strategic mindset. Evaluate the financial viability of new products and publishing initiatives using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and strong business insights. Drive feasibility analysis across products, verticals, and business opportunities through quantitative analysis, financial modelling, and strategic thinking. Analyse production economics, costs, and margins leveraging financial acumen, data analytics, and business insights. Own Gross Margin analysis, including identifying and explaining key drivers and variances through strong quantitative skills, financial analysis, and effective communication. Support decisions around product investments, pricing, volumes, and profitability using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a strategic mindset. Act as the finance partner who connects creative/publishing decisions with commercial outcomes through strong consulting skills, stakeholder management, business insights, and effective communication. Author Content Economics Act as the Finance SPOC for the Author Engagement Programme, building trusted relationships through strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Manage financial aspects relating to author royalties and contracts, applying financial acumen, quantitative skills, and sound commercial judgment. Analyse royalty structures and their impact on product economics and margins through data analytics, financial modelling, and business insights. Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure commercial and financial considerations are incorporated into author/content decisions, leveraging consulting skills, stakeholder management, and effective communication. Process Excellence Finance Transformation Identify opportunities to make commercial finance processes simpler, faster, and more effective through business insights, data analytics, and a continuous improvement mindset. Develop and implement robust finance processes across business functions, balancing stakeholder requirements while demonstrating strong consulting skills and stakeholder management. Drive standardisation and consistency in financial processes and reporting through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and process discipline. Develop a strong understanding of financial reporting systems and data architecture, leveraging data analytics, quantitative skills, and a global perspective on best practices. Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial information, including cross-charges and recharges, through strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and analytical rigor. Look for opportunities to improve reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities using data analytics, business insights, and financial modelling techniques. Business Partnering Stakeholder Management Become the Finance face and SPOC for business and functional leaders, demonstrating exceptional stakeholder management, consulting skills, and communication effectiveness. Build strong relationships across Finance, Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and other functions by effectively balancing stakeholder needs and fostering collaboration. Be comfortable working across different levels of the organisation, including senior management, demonstrating strong communication skills, business partnering capability, and a global perspective. Challenge constructively, influence decisions, and bring a commercial finance perspective to business discussions through strong consulting skills, strategic mindset, financial acumen, and business insights.

description:
Job Summary 
 What is special about Lighthouse Lighthouse is built on a foundation of unique, compassionate, highly driven individuals. We elevate the strengths and talents of those around us while leveraging opportunities for growth. We offer the experience of solving complex problems while continuing to grow multiple facets of your career. Lighthouse is where innovation meets support and where collaboration is the key ingredient to success. We grow together and are stronger together. 
 
 Role Overview 
 The Technical Analyst will provide 24x7 global (US/UK/India) IT support for our hardware and software used in production, manage/deliver content and services to technology teams and other departments in the organization. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Provide Tier I/II support to end users with exceptional customer service skills. Answer, evaluate and prioritize service requests via chat, email and in person for users. Provides regular and timely updates to customers. Perform move/add/change tasks for desktop/laptop hardware and software systems. Meet SLA requirements for problem resolution. Log and track issues in our service management tools. Build/deploy, patch and support end user desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and other related equipment. Maintain accurate inventory of computer hardware and software assets related to the service desk function. Maintain key performance metrics related to Tier I/II support functions. Manage vendor repair and returns of defective equipment as necessary. Learn eDiscovery applications to assist with support across the organization. Maintain best practices on security for supported applications. Keep manager and other team members informed of trends, delays or complications that arise during the normal course of work. Collaborate with other IT team members as needed. Participate in creation and maintenance of IT standards and procedures. Participate in on call shift rotations periodically (including evenings and weekends). Perform other related duties as assigned. 
 
 Requirements 
 B.S. in Computer Science or a related field. 1 to 3 years of previous service desk/end user support experience in a corporate environment. Hands-on experience servicing/troubleshooting desktops, laptops, printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals. Experience supporting Microsoft Office, Office 365 administration and other application software. Demonstrated ability to build, maintain and support workstation images. Demonstrated ability to work with vendors to procure, inventory, repair, and manage computing assets. Experience managing remote desktop, Citrix/VMware View/Cloud PC environments. Ability to effectively collaborate within an IT team with shared responsibilities. Working/practical knowledge of IP networking principles Working/practical knowledge of Active Directory, Exchange, and SharePoint Willing to be on-call for occasional night and/or weekend support. Prefer Microsoft certifications commensurate with position. ITIL V3 certification desired Experience with Service Now 
 
 Work Environment 
 Duties are performed in a typical office environment while at a desk or computer table. Duties require the ability to use a computer, communicate over the telephone, and read printed material, in a quiet and professional setting. Duties may require being on call periodically and working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends). This position will work for and be employed by Lighthouses India subsidiary, which is an independent company located in India.

title: Mainframe Application Support Engineer
description:
Job Summary As a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, you ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients - which means some of the biggest in the world. There s never a typical day as a Mainframe Application Support Engineer at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients. Responsibilities Provide L2/L3 production support for mainframe applications built on Natural and Adabas, ensuring high availability and operational stability. Monitor application performance, troubleshoot incidents, and resolve production issues within agreed SLA timelines. Perform root cause analysis of application failures and implement preventive solutions to minimize recurring issues. Support batch processing, online transactions, job scheduling, and production release activities across environments. Collaborate with business users, development teams, and infrastructure teams to drive timely issue resolution and service improvements. Maintain operational documentation, support change and release management processes, and ensure compliance with security, audit, and business continuity requirements. Who You Are You're good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you're open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise 4+ Years of experience in Mainframe Application Support with a focus on Natural and Adabas technologies. Proven experience working in IBM z/OS environments with solid knowledge of JCL, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, and mainframe utilities. Good understanding of CICS, VSAM, batch processing, job scheduling, and production support operations. Experience supporting mission-critical applications in a 24x7 production environment, including incident, problem, and change management processes. Hands-on experience with scheduling and monitoring tools such as CA-7, Control-M, OPC/TWS, or equivalent. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and data correction skills for Natural/Adabas applications. Experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM tools for incident and service request management. Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across global teams. Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Familiarity with application deployment, release management, and environment migration activities. Knowledge of Adabas performance monitoring, database support fundamentals, and application optimization techniques. Exposure to ITIL-based service management practices and continuous service improvement initiatives. Experience participating in on-call production support, major incident management, and disaster recovery exercises. Understanding of automation, operational efficiency, and proactive monitoring practices within mainframe environments. Being You The Kyn in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we're excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging - being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team - is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That s The Kyndryl Way.

Administrative & Operational Support Manage travel planning, itineraries, bookings, and logistics. Handle vendor coordination and office administration. Maintain meeting records and business documentation. Coordinate professionally with clients, partners, and leadership teams. Prepare executive summaries, status reports, and briefing notes.

 Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be: Disciplined, highly responsive, and dependable. Proactive, execution-oriented, and accountable. Strong at follow-through and anticipating potential issues. Calm and composed under pressure. Capable of working independently without constant supervision. Comfortable managing sensitive information and executive priorities. Effective at coordinating people, projects, and deadlines across departments. 

 Work Details Location: Noida, Sector 62 Work Arrangement: Full-Time, In-Office Working Days: 5.5 days per week Preferred Location: Noida and Delhi NCR Joining Preference: Immediate joiners preferred

Opportunities to contribute to strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects. Potential career growth into Founder's Office, Business Operations, or Operations Leadership. 

 Why Join WebBee? Work directly with the Founder on strategic and operational initiatives. Learn how a global SaaS and eCommerce technology business scales. Gain exposure to Product, Technology, Sales, HR, Operations, and leadership execution. Work in a fast-growing environment with opportunities for professional development.

Candidates with the relevant Executive Assistant experience, professional maturity, organizational skills, and ability to manage executive responsibilities are welcome to explore this opportunity. WebBee welcomes applications from qualified professionals and is committed to equal opportunity in recruitment.

These individuals collaborate with subject matter specialists and project teams to strategize effective ways to locate, assess, educate and train employees, in line with market developments and firm strategy. In staffing and deployment at PwC, your work will focus on managing and optimising the deployment of employees within the organisation, getting the right talent to the right place at the right time. We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Specialist - Resource Management to support staffing, workforce planning, and resource deployment activities across projects and business units. The individual will work closely with business leaders, project managers, hiring stakeholders, and delivery teams to ensure effective resource allocation and utilization. The ideal candidate should have experience in resource management, workforce planning, staffing operations, and stakeholder coordination, with a strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage end-to-end staffing and resource allocation across projects and engagements. Partner with business and project stakeholders to understand resource requirements and deployment timelines. Track resource availability, utilization, billability, and forecasting metrics. Coordinate with Talent Acquisition and hiring teams to fulfill resource demands within agreed timelines. Support workforce planning initiatives, including capacity planning and demand-supply analysis. Maintain resource management dashboards, reports, and staffing trackers. Ensure resource data accuracy across workforce management tools and systems. Facilitate deployment planning, resource movements, extensions, and project transitions. title: Application Production Support Consultant (Rotational Shifts)
description:
Job Summary 
 Application Production Support Consultant (Rotational Shifts) At SimCorp, delivering reliable and high-quality services is essential to maintaining the trust of our clients and supporting their critical business operations. As a Service Delivery Consultant, you will be part of a global service delivery environment responsible for supporting business-critical applications and ensuring smooth day-to-day production operations. You will play an important role in monitoring services, responding to alerts and client requests, troubleshooting production issues, and working with internal teams to restore and improve services. This role provides an opportunity to combine technical problem-solving, service management and client communication while working with colleagues and clients across different geographies. Experience within banking, financial services or capital markets will be an advantage. 

 What You Will Be Responsible For 
 Monitor production applications, emails, system alerts, service requests and support tickets, ensuring timely investigation and follow-up Troubleshoot and resolve application and production support issues, escalating to relevant technical or functional teams when required Use PL/SQL for troubleshooting, data analysis and investigation of application-related issues. Develop, maintain or execute PowerShell scripts to support operational activities, monitoring and process automation. Support service delivery activities in line with agreed SLAs and service management processes. Work within an ITIL-based service management environment, including areas such as Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management. Collaborate with internal technical, functional and infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve production issues. Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders regarding incidents, service requests, progress and resolution. Maintain accurate documentation, support records, operational procedures and client-facing information. Review recurring operational issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous service improvement. Participate in client and internal service meetings, provide operational updates and follow up on agreed actions. Support implementation of service improvements, application changes and new or enhanced services. Work effectively in a global delivery environment, collaborating with teams and stakeholders across multiple geographies. 

 What We Value 

 Technical and service capabilities 
 Hands-on experience with PL/SQL, including the ability to investigate and troubleshoot application/data-related issues. Experience with PowerShell scripting for operational support or automation. Practical understanding of production/application support, including monitoring, incident investigation, service requests and ticket management. Understanding of ITIL principles and service management processes. ITIL certification is beneficial but not mandatory. Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment. Experience with monitoring and ticketing/service-management tools is an advantage. 

 Business and industry experience 
 Previous experience in banking applications or financial services technology is highly desirable. Exposure to capital markets, investment management or financial services would be an advantage. Experience working within large IT/service organizations, consulting firms or similar global delivery environments is valuable. Experience supporting clients or teams across multiple countries or geographies is preferred. 

 Personal qualities 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to problem solving. A strong customer and service-oriented mindset. Ability to take ownership of issues and drive them toward resolution while involving the appropriate teams when necessary. Comfortable working collaboratively within a global and multicultural environment. Proactive approach to identifying recurring issues and opportunities to improve service quality and operational efficiency. 

 Other Requirements 
 Flexibility to work in rotational shifts (6AM-3 PM IST 2-11 PM IST) Willing to work on weekends and holidays Hybrid working arrangements (at least 2x a week in the office)

title: Senior VoIP Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior VoIP Infrastructure Engineer to manage and maintain a large, multi-server Asterisk PBX environment. The role involves Asterisk dial-plan and AGI development, Linux and container hosting, networking, databases, asynchronous messaging, cloud infrastructure, and observability. 
 The ideal candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting SIP protocols and dial plans at a low level while automating, deploying, and managing cloud infrastructure at scale. The candidate will work closely with VoIP and Network Operations Centre (NOC) teams to ensure system reliability, performance, and availability. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design and develop advanced Asterisk dial plans, including large machine-generated dial plans, AGI scripting, and dynamic dial-plan generation using PHP, Python, or Bash. Work with Asterisk, AGI, AMI, chan_sip, and PJSIP. Set up, manage, and troubleshoot WebRTC and SIP technologies, including ICE/STUN/TURN, SIP over TLS, and SRTP. Build and maintain browser-based softphones using SIP.js or JsSIP. Maintain and optimize PBX services across Debian, CentOS, and Rocky Linux environments, including systemd, package management, and performance tuning. Manage routing, firewalls, NAT, and port forwarding for SIP/RTP traffic, including iptables/nftables and VoIP NAT traversal. Deploy and manage LXC and Docker containers, including Docker Compose and a Next.js front end from a monorepo. Provision and manage AWS infrastructure for PBX and Call Detail Record (CDR) pipelines, including EC2, S3, VPC/security groups, IAM, SQS, and SNS. Administer MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and PostgreSQL databases for CDR and application data. Build and maintain event pipelines for media processing and CDR sharing using RabbitMQ or AWS SQS/SNS. Maintain Python-based CDR microservices that publish messages to SQS, link recordings stored in S3, and notify stakeholders using boto3. Implement centralized log analysis, monitoring, and alerting using Loki, Grafana, or equivalent observability tools. Manage backup and restoration procedures, Git-based change control, and Ansible orchestration across the server farm. Design and maintain master-slave and high-availability architectures to support a 99.99% uptime target. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications 
 Proven hands-on production experience managing and operating Asterisk PBX infrastructure at scale. Strong understanding of ICE, WebRTC, SIP/TLS, and SRTP, with practical experience building or maintaining browser-based softphones using SIP.js or JsSIP. Significant hands-on production experience with AWS services, including EC2, S3, IAM, VPC/networking, SQS, and SNS. Strong experience deploying and operating LXC and Docker containers in production environments, beyond local development. Proficiency in scripting with Python, TypeScript, PHP, and Bash. Strong Linux administration skills across multiple distributions, along with knowledge of networking, firewalls, and NAT for VoIP. Experience with at least two of the following databases: MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and PostgreSQL. Experience with RabbitMQ or an equivalent message broker. Familiarity with Ansible or similar configuration-management tools, Git-based version control, and structured change-management practices. Experience designing or maintaining master-slave or high-availability architectures. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. 
 Good to Have 
 Experience with Next.js or modern JavaScript front-end development. Familiarity with Grafana, Loki, or equivalent monitoring and observability platforms. Experience in telecom-related domains, such as contact centres, call recording, or compliance systems.

Support industrialization, site, pre-commissioning. Issue, review and approve drawings. Issue, review and approve design documentation. Carry out validation and contribute to reporting of tests. description:
The role in one line You own post-production across a creative agency and a consulting group cinematic brand films one week, founder interviews and campaign cutdowns the next. RoughCut Labs has 13+ years of work across fashion, entertainment and brand, with campaigns for names like Coca-Cola, DLF, Tanishq, Reliance Brands and Jack Daniel’s. You will be editing at that standard, while also building the Group’s own content engine. Both matter. What you'll actually do Editing and post-production Edit brand films, campaign videos, product films, event recaps and fashion content for RoughCut Labs clients from rushes to final master Cut long-form Group content — founder interviews, thought leadership, deal explainers, webinars — and derive short-form cutdowns for each platform Handle the full post chain: ingest, sync, assembly, rough cut, fine cut, colour grade, sound design, mix, titling, delivery Design and animate motion graphics, lower thirds, kinetic typography, infographic sequences and title packages Master and deliver to platform specifications — aspect ratios, codecs, bitrates, caption files, thumbnail frames Craft and story Make editorial judgements, not just technical ones — pace, rhythm, where a cut lands, what to cut entirely Work from a brief and a storyboard, and flag early when the footage will not support the intended story Maintain a consistent visual language across each brand while letting client work carry its own identity Production and pipeline Support on set where needed — DIT duties, data wrangling, backup discipline, shot review against the edit plan Own the media pipeline: asset management, project structure, naming conventions, archive and backup policy Manage multiple edits against client and campaign deadlines, and run revision rounds without losing versions Brief and review work from freelance editors and motion designers during high-volume periods First 90 days looks like success if You are running your own edits end to end without supervision, the media pipeline is documented and followed, and turnaround on standard formats has visibly shortened. title: Network Manager
description:
Network Manager L2/L3 SME & Network Architecture Lead Location: Noida or Gurugram, India
 Shift: Evening/Night Shift (5:30 PM – 2:30AM) Both side Cab facility will be provided 
 Experience Required: 10+ years in networking
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 About the Role We are looking for a Network Manager who is both a hands-on L2/L3 Subject Matter Expert (SME) and a proven people leader. You will own network architecture, stability and roadmap for our voice-led KPO/BPO operations, lead the network engineers and IT SWAT team, and remain the final technical escalation point for the toughest issues. You are accountable for outcomes, not only fixes: uptime, voice quality, team capability and client confidence in our network. You will balance deep technical credibility with strong communication and people management. 
 Environment You Will Own Firewall: SonicWall (primary + secondary/HA), dual ISP, IPSec site-to-site VPN to client peer IP Switching: approx. 15 L3/core devices and 100 L2 access switches Wi-Fi: approx. 30 access points Servers: approx. 10 servers Voice: Vonage DID over internet, VDI-based agent desktops Locations: 3 sites (Noida 2, Gurugram) Monitoring: Zabbix, OPManager (distributed, proxy per site) with SNMP, syslog and scripted path monitoring 
 Key Responsibilities Network architecture and strategy Own the end-to-end network architecture across three sites: WAN/ISP design, dual-ISP and SonicWall HA failover, IPSec VPN to client peers, L3 core and L2 access design, Wi-Fi, and the VDI and voice traffic paths. Define and maintain the network roadmap, capacity plan and lifecycle/refresh plan, with business cases and budgets for IT leadership. Lead design reviews for new sites, new client onboarding, client-mandated connectivity and security requirements, and changes to voice infrastructure. Align the network design with global client security, compliance and audit expectations (for example ISO 27001 and client-specific requirements). L2/L3 SME and escalation ownership Be the final technical authority for firewall, switching, VPN, WAN, VDI connectivity and voice-path issues, and decide whether an issue is fixed on the spot or escalated to a vendor or ISP. Lead triage and the incident bridge on major disruptions, isolating LAN, WAN, VPN, firewall, VDI or carrier-side causes while giving clear updates to leadership and client stakeholders. Diagnose complex IPSec VPN problems (Phase 1/Phase 2 failures, IKE negotiation errors, SA lifetime mismatches, DPD misconfiguration) and interpret traceroute/MTR output and firewall and switch logs. Own root cause analysis and problem management for recurring issues, and track permanent fixes to closure instead of repeating quick fixes. Voice quality and resilience Own voice-quality escalations (jitter, packet loss, MOS, one-way audio, call drops) and decide whether the fix is internal (QoS, shaping, configuration) or needs Vonage engagement. Design, tune and validate QoS so voice (RTP/SIP) is prioritised on shared internet links. Validate dual-ISP failover behaviour and confirm the VPN and voice services re-establish cleanly after a failover. Monitoring, reporting and governance Own the Zabbix monitoring strategy: templates, triggers, severity mapping (P1–P4), dependencies and escalation actions, plus VPN tunnel and MTR/path monitoring to the client peer IP and US voice/application endpoints. Own the weekly issue-trend report and client-facing service reviews: recurring root causes, closure status and permanent-fix proposals. Define and enforce incident, change and problem management processes (ITIL), change windows, runbooks, and network DR/BCP documentation. Team leadership Lead, coach and develop the network engineers and the IT SWAT team across shifts: set goals, review performance, plan skills growth, manage rosters and coverage, and build succession. Build runbooks, escalation matrices and training so that one-engineer-per-shift coverage works without depending on a single person. Hire and onboard network talent, and set the standard for technical interviews and capability assessment. Build a blameless culture of root cause analysis and continuous improvement. Vendor and stakeholder management Own the relationships and SLAs with SonicWall, ISPs and Vonage; manage escalations and provide input on renewals and contracts. Communicate with global clients, operations heads and IT leadership, explaining technical issues and trade-offs in business terms. Partner with Operations, Information Security and Infrastructure teams on changes, audits and client requirements. Required Skills and Experience 12+ years in enterprise networking, with deep experience in the KPO/BPO/ITES industry or a similar voice-dependent, client-facing operation. Global experience: has supported or delivered networks for international clients and worked with multi-region stakeholders and teams. Proven network architecture capability: multi-site design with HA, dual-ISP, IPSec VPN and QoS for voice. Expert, credible hands-on L2/L3 knowledge: firewalls (SonicWall strongly preferred), switching, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP and routing. Advanced IPSec VPN troubleshooting, and strong QoS and traffic-shaping knowledge for VoIP; Vonage or similar SIP trunk/DID experience is a plus.  ABOUT THE HUB Bureau Veritas is building a greenfield HR Shared Services hub in Noida. The hub will bring HR operations that currently run separately in each country into one standardised, digitally enabled service centre. You will design your tower, move work into Noida in structured waves, and run it at scale to global standards. 
 ROLE PURPOSE You are the hub's performance and improvement engine. You will build the Intelligent Command Centre that gives leaders one real-time view of service health across every tower. You will also run the continuous improvement system that moves the hub from stable operations to best-in-class service. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. Transition and shared services set-up Design the hub's performance framework: a KPI tree, SLA definitions, data sources and a reporting cadence shared by all towers. Capture and certify the pre-transition baselines for each country, so the hub can prove its value against the starting point. Support the transition PMO with readiness scorecards, go/no-go dashboards and hypercare tracking for every wave. Set up the Intelligent Command Centre, covering architecture, data pipelines, dashboards and alerting. 2. Process ownership and service delivery Run the ICC day to day, with real-time SLA, volume, backlog and escalation monitoring across R2P, R2H, Q2R and A2W. Lead the hub's governance rhythm: daily stand-ups, weekly tower reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly business reviews with stakeholders. Own the hub-wide customer voice programme, including CSAT and NPS surveys, closing the loop with respondents, and reporting insight. Run hub-level capacity and productivity analytics to support resourcing decisions. 3. Governance, risk and controls Own the hub quality management system, covering process documentation standards, internal quality audits and control testing across towers. Maintain the hub risk register and the tracking of issues and actions. Build data governance for performance reporting so that there is one version of the truth. 4. Continuous improvement and digital Build and govern the hub-wide continuous improvement backlog. Prioritise by value and effort, and agree ownership with each GPO. Lead improvement projects using Lean, Six Sigma and process mining. Track benefits through to realised savings. Run the hub's automation and AI pipeline, from idea intake to business case, delivery and benefits tracking. Build a continuous improvement culture through training, recognition and a simple way for every employee to raise ideas. 5. People leadership, performance and culture Build the tower's team from the ground up. Define the structure, spans of control, role profiles and hiring plan for each transition wave. Recruit, onboard and develop team leads and specialists. Build succession cover for every critical role before the tower reaches steady state. Run a disciplined people-performance cycle covering goal setting, monthly one-to-ones, quarterly reviews and calibrated year-end ratings. Keep attrition, absence and engagement at or better than hub targets. Act early on hotspots. Model the hub culture of ownership, customer focus, speed with control and learning. Make it visible in how the team works every day. Build capability through skills matrices, cross-training and certification paths. Create career moves across towers. 
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE First 90 days: hub KPI framework, baseline method and ICC design signed off. By go-live: ICC live with real-time dashboards for the first transition wave, and the governance rhythm running. Within 1218 months: continuous improvement portfolio delivering measurable, validated benefits, with hub-wide dashboards trusted by global stakeholders. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Hub-wide SLA adherence: 95% across towers Validated CI benefits: Annual savings and hours released against target Automation hours released: Increased year on year Reporting timeliness and accuracy: 100% on schedule Hub CSAT / NPS: At or above target Audit and quality findings: Closed within agreed timelines CI participation: % of employees who submitted or delivered an improvement Targets are indicative. They will be finalised in the hub SLA framework and country baselines. 
 TECHNICAL SKILLS Performance management and command-centre design for multi-tower shared services. Lean Six Sigma methods, including DMAIC, value-stream mapping and root-cause analysis. Data analytics and visualisation (Power BI or Tableau). SQL or data-modelling skills are an advantage. Process mining (Celonis, Signavio or similar) and automation pipeline management (RPA, AI). ITIL service level management and quality management systems. Benefits realisation and business case development. 
 LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Customer-centric leadership Builds teams from zero Drives change and adoption Sound judgement under pressure Influences without authority across countries Data-led decision making Coaches and develops talent Holds a high bar on control 
 EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS Essential 15+ years of experience, including 7+ years in shared services performance, excellence or transformation roles. Has built and run an ICC, command centre or equivalent governance function. Has deployed continuous improvement frameworks across multi-tower shared services centres. Lean Six Sigma Black Belt. Master's degree in Business, HR, Engineering or a related field. Preferred Transition PMO experience Process mining certification Change management certification (Prosci or equivalent)

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Role Profile & Job Description 
 Position Title: Design Manager Department: Engineering / Product Design & 
 Development Reports To: Head of Engineering / Director of Operations 
 Role Overview 
 The Design Manager is responsible for leading the design engineering function, 
 overseeing end-to-end design operations from initial concept through production 
 handoff. This role blends technical leadership, design validation, resource planning, 
 and cross-functional coordination with manufacturing, quality, and project 
 management teams to ensure deliverables meet functional, aesthetic, quality, and 
 budgetary requirements. 
 Core Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities 
 Design Leadership & Project Execution: Lead, mentor, and allocate work across the 
 design engineering team to meet project milestones. Direct product design 
 workflows: concept modeling, detailed 3D CAD modeling, 2D drafting, assembly 
 generation, and Bill of Materials (BOM) creation. Establish and maintain 
 standardized design libraries, revision control, and Product Data Management 
 (PDM/PLM) protocols. 
 Design Validation & Compliance: 
 Conduct thorough Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) 
 reviews prior to tooling and fabrication release. Ensure engineering calculations, 
 tolerance stack-up analyses, and simulations (FEA/stress analysis) comply with 
 functional and safety standards. Verify that all technical documentation, engineering 
 change orders (ECOs), and production drawings adhere to applicable industry 
 standards (ISO, ASME, DIN). 
 Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination: 
 Collaborate closely with production, tooling, and fabrication units to resolve design- 
 related issues on the shop floor. Coordinate with vendors, prototype developers, and 
 component suppliers regarding material specifications, tooling feasibility, and sample 
 approvals. Support the quality control team by establishing inspection benchmarks, 
 critical-to-quality (CTQ) dimensions, and testing parameters. 
 Process Improvement & Team Development: 
 Implement best practices in CAD automation, modeling standards, and digital workflow 
 optimization. Drive continuous cost-reduction initiatives through value engineering 
 and material optimization. Conduct periodic technical training and performance 
 reviews for junior engineers and draftsmen. 
 Performance Indicators (KPIs ) 
 On-Time Release: Punctual delivery of design freezes, production drawings, and ECO 
 approvals. 
 First-Time-Right (FTR) Rate: Minimization of design revisions post-tooling or during 
 pilot production. 
 Cost & Weight Optimization: Measurable reductions in material usage or manufacturing 
 cycle time via value engineering. 
 Team Throughput: Effective task distribution and development of team capabilities.

 We are looking for a responsible, organised and proactive Stores & Export Operations Executive to manage inventory, material movement, logistics and dispatch operations at our manufacturing facility.  Role & responsibilities 1. Inventory & Store Management Maintain accurate inventory records for fabrics, accessories, packaging materials and finished goods. Manage daily inward and outward movement of raw materials and finished products. Verify incoming materials against purchase orders, invoices and delivery challans. Conduct basic fabric inspections, including quantity, width, GSM, colour and visible defects. Maintain material issuance records for cutting, printing and production. Perform regular physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies. Monitor stock levels and proactively report material shortages. Ensure proper identification, storage and organisation of inventory. 2. Export Logistics & Dispatch Coordinate domestic and international shipments, primarily exports to Australia. Prepare and maintain packing lists, commercial invoices and shipment documentation. Coordinate with courier companies, freight forwarders and logistics partners. title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
About Rightsline: 
 At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the worlds most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology. 
 Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control. 
 At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide. 
 Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference. 
 What You Will Own: 
 Instance Configuration & Governance Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes. Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step. Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects. Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use. Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes. 
 Workflow, Automation & App Administration Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration. Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state. Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus. Administer our Marketplace apps including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent. 
 Confluence & Process Documentation Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy. Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives. Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes. 
 Reporting, Data & Integrations Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence. Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost. Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely. Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus. Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors. 
 Access, Compliance & Support Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when. Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management. Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks 
 What You Bring: 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration. Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management). ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps. Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics. Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires. Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration. Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection. Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira. Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change. Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping. Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates. Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations. Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction. Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on. Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative. Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones.

description:

Perform database testing and data validation using SQL and PostgreSQL. Verify data consistency across application modules and integrations. Test API integrations with third-party and enterprise systems.

 Team Collaboration Work closely with developers, business analysts, product teams, and technical leads. Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives. Support UAT, production validation, and release testing. 
 Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 28 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and the SDLC/STLC. Hands-on experience with manual testing, functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing. Experience with API testing using Postman or similar tools. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL. Understanding of test case design, defect lifecycle, and bug-tracking tools such as Jira. Experience with test management and documentation. Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. 
 Good to Have Experience with Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or other automation frameworks. Knowledge of Python, Java, or JavaScript for test automation. Experience with JMeter or other performance testing tools. Familiarity with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Understanding of OWASP Top 10 and application security testing. Experience testing enterprise applications, REST APIs, and complex business workflows. Exposure to BFSI, government, legal technology, or regulated enterprise applications. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

title: Administration Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and proactive Admin Manager to oversee administrative operations across our corporate office and plant location in Delhi NCR. The candidate will be responsible for facility management, infrastructure maintenance, vendor management, security, housekeeping, transport, employee facilities, statutory compliance coordination, and administrative budgeting. The role requires effective coordination with HR, Finance, Procurement, Plant Operations, and other departments to ensure smooth, cost-effective, and compliant administrative operations. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 1. Corporate & Plant Administration Manage day-to-day administrative operations at corporate and plant locations. Ensure smooth functioning of office facilities, plant infrastructure, and employee amenities. Develop and implement administrative policies, procedures, and standard operating practices. Conduct regular facility inspections and ensure timely resolution of administrative issues. 2. Facility & Infrastructure Management Oversee maintenance of office premises, plant buildings, electrical systems, plumbing, air conditioning, and other infrastructure. Manage preventive maintenance schedules and coordinate repairs with relevant vendors and internal teams. Ensure proper upkeep of meeting rooms, workstations, common areas, washrooms, pantry, and plant facilities. Coordinate Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) for equipment, utilities, and facility-related services. 3. Housekeeping & Pantry Management Supervise housekeeping, pantry, and facility-support staff across locations. Ensure cleanliness, hygiene, sanitation, and workplace discipline. Monitor pantry supplies, drinking water, refreshments, and other employee facilities. Establish service standards and conduct periodic inspections to maintain quality. 4. Security & Safety Coordination Manage security personnel, visitor management, access control, and entry/exit procedures. Coordinate deployment and monitoring of security guards at corporate and plant locations. Ensure proper maintenance of visitor registers, security logs, and incident reports. Coordinate with the EHS and plant teams on fire safety, emergency preparedness, and workplace safety requirements. 5. Vendor & Contract Management Identify, evaluate, negotiate, and manage vendors for housekeeping, security, transport, maintenance, and other administrative services. Manage vendor agreements, service-level expectations, quotations, and renewals. Monitor vendor performance, service quality, and adherence to agreed timelines. Coordinate vendor bills, service confirmations, and invoice processing with the Finance team. 6. Transport & Travel Management Manage employee transportation, vehicle allocation, and official travel arrangements, wherever applicable. Coordinate vehicle maintenance, fuel expenses, driver deployment, and transport vendor services. Ensure proper maintenance of vehicle documents, insurance, permits, and related records. Optimize transport utilization and control associated costs. 7. Administrative Budgeting & Cost Control Prepare and monitor the administrative budget for corporate and plant locations. Track expenses related to maintenance, housekeeping, security, utilities, transport, and office supplies. Identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising service quality. Maintain expense records, prepare MIS reports, and share periodic updates with management. 8. Procurement & Inventory Management Manage procurement of stationery, office supplies, pantry materials, furniture, and other administrative requirements. Maintain inventory records, stock registers, and minimum stock levels. Coordinate with the Purchase and Finance teams for purchase requisitions, approvals, and invoice processing. Ensure timely availability and proper utilization of administrative assets and consumables. 9. Employee Facilities & General Services Ensure availability of essential employee facilities at corporate and plant locations. Coordinate seating arrangements, office shifting, workstation allocation, and facility requirements for new joiners. Support HR in employee engagement activities, celebrations, meetings, and other organizational events. Address employee concerns related to administrative services and ensure timely resolution. 10. Statutory Documentation & Compliance Coordination Maintain administrative records, vendor documents, service agreements, licenses, and facility-related documentation. Coordinate renewals of applicable registrations, permits, and licenses with the relevant internal teams and external agencies. Support compliance with applicable fire safety, building, environmental, and other location-specific requirements. Coordinate inspections, audits, and documentation requirements with relevant stakeholders. 11. Asset & Records Management Maintain an updated register of office furniture, equipment, vehicles, and other administrative assets. Monitor asset allocation, movement, repair, and disposal records. Ensure proper documentation and accountability for company-owned assets. Maintain organized administrative files and records for audits and management reviews. 12. Team Management & Reporting Lead and supervise administrative staff, security personnel, housekeeping teams, drivers, and other support staff. Define responsibilities, monitor performance, and ensure adherence to service standards. Prepare periodic MIS reports covering expenses, maintenance, vendor performance, inventory, and facility operations. Coordinate with HR, Finance, Purchase, IT, EHS, and Plant Operations to ensure effective cross-functional support. 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Graduate in any discipline; MBA or a relevant qualification in Administration, Facility Management, or Operations will be an added advantage. 7-12 years of relevant experience in administration, preferably in a manufacturing, industrial, or corporate environment. Experience managing both corporate office and plant administration is strongly preferred. Strong knowledge of facility management, vendor management, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and administrative budgeting. Experience in handling multiple locations, administrative teams, and service providers. Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, documentation, and administrative systems. Good communication, negotiation, coordination, and team-management skills.

Key Skills: Administration Management,Petty Cash Management,Travel Arrangements,Government Liasoning,Facility Administration,Housekeeping Management,Facility Management,Cafeteria Management

description:
Job Description Summary 
The Lead Sourcing Specialist 2 will be responsible for leading sourcing and procurement activities for Turbine Parts Procurement. This role requires strong expertise in supplier development, strategic sourcing, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, quality, delivery performance, and compliance with applicable engineering and industry requirements.
The ideal candidate will have significant experience in sourcing engineered components, preferably within industries such as power, oil gas, heavy engineering, static equipment, or related manufacturing environments. The candidate should be capable of working closely with engineering, quality, manufacturing, and project teams to ensure reliable and cost-effective supply of critical pressure-containing components. 

 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities Lead sourcing activities for Turbine Parts Procurement , including supplier identification, qualification, development, and performance management. Develop and execute sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives for cost, quality, delivery, and risk mitigation. Manage supplier relationships for critical engineered components and ensure continuity of supply. Drive supplier negotiations covering pricing, commercial terms, contracts, delivery schedules, and long-term agreements. Partner with engineering and quality teams to ensure suppliers meet technical specifications, regulatory requirements, and quality standards. Support supplier selection and qualification processes for pressure vessel and pressure part manufacturing. Monitor supplier performance through key metrics such as on-time delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost competitiveness. Identify and implement cost reduction, productivity, and value engineering opportunities without compromising quality or compliance. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including engineering, project management, manufacturing, quality, and logistics teams. Assess supply market conditions, supplier capabilities, and business risks to proactively address supply constraints. Ensure compliance with company sourcing policies, EHS requirements, and applicable industry codes and standards. Resolve supplier-related issues and drive corrective actions to support business continuity and customer commitments. Maintain accurate sourcing documentation, contracts, and supplier records. Support localization, dual sourcing, and supplier capacity expansion initiatives where applicable. 
 Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering , preferably Mechanical Engineering , from an accredited university or college. Minimum 7 years of work experience in sourcing, procurement, supplier development, or supply chain management for Turbine parts. Demonstrated experience in sourcing Turbine parts Strong commercial negotiation and supplier management experience. Knowledge of manufacturing processes related to pressure parts, fabricated components, machined parts, forgings, castings, welding, and heat treatment. title: Sr IT Engineer
description:
Job Details 
 Job Title: Senior IT Engineer - Virtualization Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Organization: NEC Corporation of India Ltd. 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a System Administrator who will lead the day-to-day administration, optimization, and automation of our enterprise virtualization platforms, datacenter infrastructure, and hybrid cloud environments. The ideal candidate will ensure high availability, security, and disaster readiness of mission-critical workloads, and will support large-scale datacenter projects for government and enterprise customers. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Manage and maintain enterprise virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere, vCenter, and VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), and Nutanix AHV clusters (Prism Central/Element). Configure and tune vSphere HA, DRS, vMotion, vSAN, and Distributed Switches, and monitor cluster and host health using VMware Aria Operations. Design, implement, and test replication, failover clustering, and disaster recovery solutions (e.g., VMware SRM) for mission-critical workloads. Administer hybrid cloud environments on Google Cloud Platform and AWS, including landing zones, IAM policies, and network architecture. Administer Windows Server and Linux (RedHat, CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux) environments for performance, security, and uptime. Manage Active Directory Domain Services, DNS, and Group Policy Objects, including user and resource provisioning. Plan and execute patching of servers, ESXi hosts, and workstations using WSUS, ensuring compliance with organizational policies. Execute VM migrations across platforms (VMware, Nutanix, Hyper-V, Proxmox VE) using tools such as Nutanix Move. Build and deploy datacenter infrastructure, including server installation, storage and RAID configuration, and OS deployment. Automate routine administration tasks using PowerShell and Ansible, and support application containerization using Docker. Manage the firmware and driver lifecycle for datacenter hardware (e.g., Dell EMC servers). Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and status reports, and coordinate with customer and internal teams. 
 
 Prerequisites 
 Qualification: B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering, IT, or a related discipline. Ideal candidate should have a minimum of 3+ years of relevant experience in system administration, virtualization, and datacenter management. Desirable qualities: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification (or equivalent AWS/Azure certification); VMware (VCP) or Nutanix (NCP) certification is an added advantage. Hands-on experience with Hyper-V, Proxmox VE, Docker, and Infrastructure-as-Code tools. Exposure to cybersecurity fundamentals and network traffic analysis. Experience in large-scale datacenter or government/public-sector projects. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to work independently and under pressure. 
 
 Base Location 
 Noida, but flexible to travel (as per project and customer requirements). 
 
 Specialization Description 
 General IT Applications Development includes analysis, programming, and configuration of end user applications and/or systems software including: Analyzing detailed business/functional/technical requirements and specifications for the application Coding internally developed applications and/or configuring commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using programming, scripting, and database languages Supporting application testing, deployment, maintenance, and evolution activities by correcting programming errors, responding to scope changes, and coding application enhancements 
 
 Level Description 
 Entry to developing level professional with little or no prior experience required. Applies a broad theoretical job knowledge typically obtained through advanced education. Work is closely supervised. Works to deliver day-to-day objectives with limited impact on achievement of results for the job area. Explains facts, policies and practices related to job area. Problems faced are not typically difficult or complex.

title: Problem Manager- IMS and CS Core
description:
About This Opportunity We are looking for a proactive and analytical Problem Manager – Core Domain to join our L1 NOC (Network Operations Center) team at Ericsson. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, and managing recurring network problems within the Core network domain, driving root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing permanent fixes to minimize network disruptions.
You will work closely with L1, L2, and L3 technical teams, service management stakeholders, and customer teams to ensure problem resolution aligns with SLA commitments and continual service improvement goals. This is a key role in strengthening operational stability and delivering a superior network experience for Ericsson's customers.   What You Will Do 

  Own end-to-end problem lifecycle management for Core network domain incidents
  Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and major incidents
  Identify problem trends through incident data analysis and proactive problem detection
  Raise and manage Problem Records in the ITSM ticketing system (ServiceNow / BMC Remedy / JIRA)
  Drive Known Error identification and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB)
  Collaborate with L1 NOC, L2, and L3 teams to facilitate timely problem investigation and resolution
  Coordinate with Core network engineers, field teams, and vendor support for problem closure
  Escalate critical or unresolved problems to senior technical leads and management as per the escalation matrix
  Interface with the customer / client teams for problem status updates and post-incident reviews
  Prepare and deliver high-quality RCA reports and Problem Management reports to internal and external stakeholders
  Document workarounds, known errors, and resolution steps in the knowledge base
  Maintain accurate problem logs, closure reports, and trend analysis records
  Support audit and compliance activities with relevant documentation 
  Analyze problem trends and recurring fault patterns to identify improvement opportunities
  Work with operations and technical teams to implement preventive actions and process improvements
  Contribute to SLA performance improvement initiatives and reduction of repeat incidents
  Participate in service review meetings and provide problem management inputs   What You Will Bring 

  Good understanding of Core network technologies – IMS, VoLTE, EPC, 4G/5G Core, CS Core, MSS, MGW, HLR/HSS
  Familiarity with telecom network architecture and end-to-end service flow in Core domain
  Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow, BMC Remedy, or JIRA
  Understanding of alarm monitoring platforms and NMS/EMS tools
  Working knowledge of ITIL Problem Management processes   Experience & Qualifications 
 5-10 years of experience in telecom network operations, with at least 5 years in a Problem Management or senior NOC role
  Hands-on experience in Core domain fault management, incident analysis, or network support
  Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify patterns across large incident datasets
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills for stakeholder reporting and RCA documentation
  Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electronics / Telecommunications / Computer Science) or equivalent 
 Preferred Qualifications 
  ITIL Foundation Certification (v3 or v4) preferred
  Exposure to 24x7 NOC operations environment
  Prior experience in Managed Services / Network Operations for a telecom operator or OEM

title: Air Ticketing Executive
description:
About the Role: As an Air Ticketing Executive at EaseMyTrip.com , you will be responsible for managing flight bookings, modifications, cancellations, and customer queries related to air travel. You will interact directly with customers, travel agents, and airline partners to ensure accurate and timely ticket issuance and support. This role is ideal for someone with a strong understanding of airline reservation systems, fare rules, and a customer-first approach. You will play a vital part in delivering smooth and efficient travel experiences. 
 Key Responsibilities Flight Booking & Ticketing: Handle domestic and international flight bookings, issue tickets accurately using airline reservation systems and GDS platforms. Amendments & Cancellations: Process rebookings, date changes, cancellations, and refunds as per airline and company policies. Customer Support: Assist customers with flight-related queries over calls, emails, or chatsincluding fare details, baggage policies, seat selection, and special requests. Fare Calculation & Comparison: Calculate accurate fares, apply discounts, compare flight options, and inform customers of the most economical and convenient choices. GDS & Airline Portal Operations: Work on GDS platforms like Amadeus, Galileo, Sabre or airline-specific portals to issue, modify, or cancel tickets. PNR Management: Monitor and manage PNRs (Passenger Name Records), ensure timely ticketing, and follow up on waitlisted or unconfirmed bookings. Coordination with Airlines & Vendors: Liaise with airlines, consolidators, and backend teams to resolve booking issues, seek fare waivers, or manage special service requests (SSRs). Documentation & Reporting: Maintain booking records, transaction logs, and share MIS reports with supervisors or management as required. Policy Adherence: Follow IATA standards, airline fare rules, and company procedures to ensure accuracy and compliance in all transactions. Team Collaboration: Coordinate with customer care, holiday, and sales teams to ensure smooth delivery of flight services. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Experience: 0 to 5 years of experience in air ticketing. Freshers with strong GDS training or travel domain knowledge are welcome. Educational Qualification: Graduate in any discipline. Certification in Travel & Tourism or IATA is preferred. GDS Knowledge: Familiar with at least one Global Distribution System (GDS) like Amadeus, Galileo, or Sabre. Airline Policies: Understanding of airline fare rules, baggage policies, cancellation norms, and reissuance procedures. Communication Skills: Fluent in Hindi and English. Ability to explain travel terms clearly and confidently to customers. Customer Orientation: Polite, professional, and empathetic when handling customer concerns related to flight bookings. Tech Proficiency: Comfortable with reservation systems, airline portals, email communication, and MS Excel for reports. Detail-Oriented: High accuracy in fare calculations, PNR entries, and passenger data input. Problem Solving: Ability to handle last-minute booking challenges, fare differences, and route changes with quick turnaround. Flexibility: Willing to work in rotational shifts, weekends, and during peak travel seasons or emergencies.

Key Skills: Amadeus,GDS,Sabre,Air Ticketing,Galileo,Ticketing,Etihad,CRS
