title: Trims Sourcing Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION TRIMS SOURCING MANAGER Company: FashionC Overseas Exports Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Sourcing / Purchase
 Designation: Trims Sourcing Manager
 Location: B-7, Sector-65, Noida
 Industry: Garment Manufacturing & Export
 Reporting To: Management / Director 1. JOB SUMMARY The Trims Sourcing Manager will be responsible for end-to-end sourcing, development, costing, negotiation, vendor management, and timely procurement of garment trims and accessories required for sampling and bulk production. The candidate should have strong knowledge of the trims market, a reliable vendor network, excellent negotiation skills, and the ability to coordinate effectively with Merchandising, Design, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. The role requires strong English communication skills , including professional email communication and regular interaction with suppliers and internal teams. 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES A. Trims Sourcing & Development Source and develop all types of garment trims and accessories as per buyer, design and production requirements. Handle sourcing of: Labels and care labels Hangtags Buttons and snaps Zippers Elastics Threads Tapes and cords Interlinings Hooks and other closures Embellishments Packaging materials Polybags, cartons and other packing accessories Develop new trims as per approved samples, specifications and buyer requirements. Coordinate sample development and submit trims for approval within the required timeline. Maintain an updated database/library of available trims and suppliers. B. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop reliable new suppliers. Maintain strong relationships with existing vendors. Develop alternate suppliers for critical and frequently used trims. Evaluate vendors based on quality, price, capacity, lead time, reliability and service . Monitor supplier performance and take corrective action wherever required. Maintain a strong and updated vendor database. C. Costing & Negotiation Obtain quotations from multiple suppliers and prepare comparative statements. Negotiate price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms, quality and delivery conditions . Ensure competitive sourcing without compromising quality. Monitor market prices and identify cost-saving opportunities. Develop alternate materials/vendors wherever possible for cost optimization. D. Purchase & Order Management Raise/coordinate Purchase Orders as per approved requirements. Ensure all purchase orders clearly mention specifications, quantity, price, delivery date and approved quality standards. Track order status from placement to final delivery. Ensure trims are available as per the production TNA. Escalate potential delays immediately to management and concerned departments. Coordinate with suppliers for urgent and priority requirements. E. Quality & Compliance Ensure trims meet approved specifications, quality standards and buyer requirements. Coordinate with QA/QC for inspection and approval of trims. Resolve quality issues, shortages, damages and discrepancies with suppliers. Ensure applicable buyer-specific testing and compliance requirements are followed. Maintain proper documentation for approvals, test reports and supplier records. F. Internal Coordination Coordinate closely with: Merchandising Design Sampling Production PPC QA/QC Stores Accounts Understand upcoming production and sampling requirements and plan sourcing accordingly. Ensure smooth communication between suppliers and internal departments. Attend meetings related to sourcing, material planning and production requirements. G. MIS & Documentation Maintain updated records of: Supplier database Quotations Cost sheets Comparative statements Purchase Orders Trim approvals Supplier performance Delivery status Pending materials Cost-saving initiatives Prepare regular Trims Sourcing MIS for management. Track pending and delayed materials and highlight critical issues. H. Team Management Lead and guide the trims sourcing team. Allocate work and monitor daily sourcing activities. Ensure timely completion of sampling, costing, vendor development and procurement activities. Train team members on sourcing procedures, vendor management and documentation. Establish systematic sourcing processes and controls. 3. REQUIRED SKILLS Strong knowledge of garment trims and accessories. Strong vendor network in the trims/accessories market. Excellent vendor development and relationship-management skills. Strong costing and price negotiation skills. Good knowledge of garment manufacturing and production processes. Strong understanding of TNA and material planning. Good knowledge of buyer requirements and quality standards. Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and ERP/procurement software . Ability to manage multiple suppliers and urgent requirements. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Excellent English communication skills – mandatory. Should be able to independently draft professional emails to suppliers and internal stakeholders. Good presentation and interpersonal skills. 4. QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE Qualification: 
Graduate / Post Graduate in Textile, Fashion, Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration or a related field. Experience: 6–10 years of relevant experience in trims/accessories sourcing, purchase or procurement in the garment/apparel export industry. Experience with international garment buyers/brands will be preferred. Candidates with an established trims supplier network will be preferred. 5. KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS (KPA) Timely availability of trims for sampling and bulk production. Effective price negotiation and cost savings. Successful development of reliable vendors. Supplier quality and performance. On-time trim development and approval. On-time delivery as per production TNA. Reduction in material shortages and delays. Development of alternate suppliers. Compliance with buyer specifications and quality requirements. Accurate sourcing MIS and documentation. Effective coordination with Merchandising, Production, QA, Stores and Accounts. 6. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES Proactive and responsible. Strong ownership of work. Excellent negotiation and communication skills. Good commercial understanding. Detail-oriented and organized. Able to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines. Strong relationship-building ability. Solution-oriented approach. Willingness to take ownership of urgent production requirements. description:

We are particularly interested in someone who can use AI tools to create beautiful, engaging, and professional-looking short videos. This role requires a combination of creativity, design skills, video editing expertise, and the ability to use AI tools effectively. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Social Media Graphic Design 
 Design visually appealing social media posts, carousels, banners, and promotional creatives. Create engaging Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn graphics for different client industries. Develop clean, modern, and attractive designs that align with client branding. Convert content, ideas, and briefs into creative visual concepts. Maintain consistency in typography, colors, layouts, and brand identity. 
 2. Short-Form Video & Reel Creation 
 Create engaging short-form videos and reels for Instagram, Facebook, and other social media platforms. Edit videos with smooth transitions, animations, subtitles, music, and visual effects. Transform static graphics, scripts, and content ideas into engaging video content. Create promotional videos, educational reels, product videos, and social media ads. Ensure videos are visually appealing, engaging, and optimized for social media. 
 3. AI-Powered Creative Content 
 Use AI tools to generate high-quality images, videos, animations, and creative concepts. Create professional-looking short videos using AI video generation platforms. Write and optimize AI prompts to achieve the desired visual style, composition, motion, and storytelling. Experiment with new AI creative tools and workflows to improve content quality and production efficiency. Combine AI-generated content with traditional editing and design techniques to produce polished final creatives. 
 4. Collaboration & Execution 
 Work closely with the social media, content, and digital marketing teams. Understand creative briefs and deliver designs according to client requirements. Manage multiple client projects and meet deadlines. Incorporate feedback and make revisions while maintaining quality. Stay updated with social media trends, design styles, and emerging creative technologies. Required Skills & Tools Graphic Design Canva Advanced proficiency. Adobe Photoshop – Good working knowledge. Strong understanding of layouts, typography, color combinations, and visual hierarchy. Video Editing & Motion Graphics 
 Adobe After Effects – Good working knowledge of animations, motion graphics, and visual effects. Ability to create engaging short-form videos and reels. Knowledge of video transitions, subtitles, sound synchronization, and basic storytelling. 
 AI Content Creation 
 Hands-on experience with AI image and video generation tools. Ability to write effective AI prompts and generate visually appealing content. Familiarity with AI video platforms such as Runway, Kling, Pika, or similar tools is preferred. Ability to combine AI-generated footage with editing software to create professional-quality videos. 

 Candidate Requirements 
 1–3 years of relevant experience in graphic design, social media creatives, or video editing. A strong portfolio showcasing social media graphics, carousel designs, reels, and AI-generated videos. Creative mindset with an eye for detail and aesthetics. Ability to understand brand guidelines and follow creative briefs. Good time management and ability to handle multiple projects. Willingness to learn new AI tools and creative technologies. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 We are particularly interested in candidates who can: Create beautiful, modern, and attractive social media carousels . Design simple yet impactful graphics that capture attention. Produce engaging reels and short videos independently. Use AI tools creatively to generate high-quality video content. Take an idea or brief and turn it into a polished creative asset with minimal supervision. 
 Important: We are looking for a hands-on creative professional, not just someone who knows how to use design software. Creativity, visual quality, execution, and the ability to use AI tools effectively are equally important. 
 How to Apply

 Experience: 5–10 Years
 Salary: 50,000 – 60,000 per month 
 Naresh-(.92177-15002.) 
 About the Company BPE Innovations Pvt. Ltd. (Bharat Photon) is a growing Indian manufacturing company engaged in the production of sensor-based washroom automation and hygiene products , including sensor faucets/taps, urinal sensors, flush valves, soap dispensers, hand dryers and related electronic products. We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Purchase / Procurement who can independently manage procurement activities and develop a strong vendor network across Delhi-NCR , particularly for electronic components, electrical items, hardware, sanitary components, packaging materials and other production-related requirements. Job Summary The Assistant Manager – Purchase will be responsible for end-to-end procurement activities , including vendor identification, market sourcing, price negotiation, purchase orders, supplier development, delivery follow-up and coordination with Production, Stores, Quality, Accounts and other departments. The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Delhi-NCR markets and vendors , including Chawri Bazar and other major Delhi markets , and should be capable of sourcing materials at competitive prices while maintaining required quality and delivery timelines. Key Responsibilities 1. Purchase & Procurement Handle day-to-day procurement activities for electronic, electrical, sensor, sanitary, hardware, packaging and production-related materials . Review purchase requisitions from Production, Stores, R&D, Service and other departments. Identify suitable suppliers and obtain quotations based on material specifications and requirements. Compare quotations, negotiate prices and finalize commercial terms. Prepare and release Purchase Orders as per approved requirements and company policies. Ensure timely procurement of materials to support uninterrupted production. 2. Vendor Development & Management Identify, evaluate and develop new vendors across Delhi-NCR . Maintain a strong network of local suppliers, particularly in Delhi markets such as Chawri Bazar and other relevant industrial/electronic markets . Develop alternative sources for critical and frequently used materials. Negotiate prices, credit terms, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities and other commercial conditions. Maintain long-term professional relationships with reliable suppliers. Monitor vendor performance regarding price, quality, delivery and service . Resolve vendor-related issues and coordinate corrective actions where required. 3. Market Sourcing & Negotiation Conduct regular market visits and supplier interactions to understand current market prices and availability. Maintain updated knowledge of electronic components, electrical items, sensors, cables, connectors, PCB-related materials, hardware, sanitary components and other manufacturing materials . Negotiate aggressively but professionally to achieve cost savings and competitive procurement rates . Verify market rates through multiple suppliers before finalizing major purchases. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and supplier consolidation. 4. Production & Material Coordination Coordinate closely with Production and Stores to understand material requirements and delivery priorities. Ensure critical production materials are available on time. Follow up with suppliers for pending orders and committed delivery dates. Coordinate urgent purchases whenever required to prevent production delays. Work with the Stores team to monitor material consumption, stock levels and replenishment requirements. 5. Purchase Order & Documentation Prepare and maintain accurate Purchase Orders, quotations, comparative statements and vendor records. Maintain proper documentation related to purchases, invoices, delivery challans and supplier communications. Ensure purchase transactions are completed according to approved processes. Maintain vendor databases, price records and historical purchase data. Prepare periodic purchase reports, pending order reports and cost comparison reports for management. 6. Quality & Vendor Performance Coordinate with the Quality and Production teams regarding material quality issues. Ensure suppliers understand required specifications and quality standards. title: Manager / Sr Manager MIS and Business Intelligence
description:
Position Manager/Senior Manager Department MIS and Business Intelligence Location Noida, UP 
 Job Summary Company is looking for an experienced MIS professional to lead the transition of the MIS function from routine, transaction-level report generation to a strategic Management Information & Business Intelligence function. The incumbent will design and own dashboards, KPI scorecards, and decision-support reporting that give Directors and senior leadership real-time, actionable visibility into the business enabling faster and better-informed business calls across sales, production, quality, supply chain, and finance. 

 Company Overview A fast-growing, Made-in-India company shaping the future of the LED lighting and electrical solutions industry. With over a decade of industry experience, Its offers 1000+ product categories across residential, commercial, and industrial applications, supported by a state-of-the-art 2,00,000 sq. ft. manufacturing facility in Noida and a strong network of 12,000+ retailers across India. Our portfolio extends beyond lighting to include wires & cables, modular switches, switchgears, water heaters, and electrical accessories, enabling us to provide a complete electrical ecosystem to our customers. At Company, innovation, quality, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. Our in-house R&D capabilities and NABL-accredited laboratory ensure that our products are rigorously tested and developed in line with leading industry standards, including BIS, ISO, and RoHS. Our strong industry presence is reflected in approvals from 10 Maharatna and 9 Navratna organizations, along with partnerships with leading organizations such as ONGC, HPCL, NTPC, Indian Oil, Huawei, Tata Projects, and OYO. 
 Key Responsibilities Own end-to-end evolution of the MIS function from “data reporting” to “management information” — shifting the team’s output from static reports to insight-driven decision support. Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards (Power BI / Excel / equivalent) that consolidate data from ERP, production, quality, sales, and supply-chain systems into a single, reliable view. Partner directly with Directors and functional heads to understand the business questions behind each request, and translate them into the right metrics, cuts, and visualizations. Develop and maintain KPI scorecards across Sales, Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and HR, aligned with the organization’s KRA/KPI and incentive frameworks. Drive trend and variance analysis — sales vs. forecast, OEE and rejection trends, inventory ageing, SKU classification (Runner / Repeater / Stranger), and working-capital indicators — and proactively flag risks and opportunities to leadership. Automate recurring MIS reports and eliminate manual, Excel-heavy compilation; standardize data definitions, formats, and refresh cycles across departments. Establish data-governance practices — a single source of truth, data validation checks, and clear ownership — so leadership can trust every number in the dashboard. Prepare and present monthly/quarterly business review packs to Directors and senior leadership, with clear narrative, insight, and recommended actions — not just data. Evaluate and recommend upgrades to BI tools, reporting infrastructure, and automation (e.g., Power BI, Power Query, ERP reporting modules) as the business scales. Act as a cross-functional bridge — working closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Production, Quality, Finance, and HR to source data and understand the operational context behind it. 
 Qualifications & Skills Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Statistics, Commerce, or a related field; MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred. 8–12 years of progressive experience in MIS, Business Analytics, or Business Intelligence roles, including at least 2–3 years managing a team or reporting function. Manufacturing, FMEG, or electrical/electronics industry background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Power Query, macros) and hands-on expertise with Power BI, Tableau, or an equivalent BI/visualization tool. Working knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts; exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or similar) for data extraction and reporting. Demonstrated experience building dashboards and scorecards used directly by senior leadership for decision-making.

 Company Name: SPAC Pneumatic Job Title: Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant to Chief Managing Director Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site Gender: Male Experience: 3-5 years Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred 
 JOB Summary: SPAC Pneumatic is looking for a highly organized, proactive, responsible, and professional Male Executive Assistant to work closely with the Chief Managing Director (CMD). The selected candidate will be responsible for providing comprehensive executive, administrative, coordination, and follow-up support to ensure the CMD s daily activities and business priorities are managed efficiently. This is a high-responsibility position requiring excellent communication, professional etiquette, confidentiality, time management, and the ability to coordinate effectively with senior management, employees, clients, vendors, and other business associates. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Executive Administrative Support Manage and maintain the CMD s daily calendar, appointments, meetings, and schedules. Coordinate meetings with internal teams, clients, vendors, business partners, and other stakeholders. 
 Prepare meeting agendas, presentations, reports, documents, and other required material. Maintain records of important meetings, discussions, commitments, and follow-up points. Ensure that important tasks, deadlines, and commitments are tracked and completed on time. Assist the CMD with day-to-day administrative and business-related activities. 
 2. Coordination Follow-Up Coordinate with different departments on behalf of the CMD. Follow up with concerned employees and departments regarding pending tasks and assignments. Track the progress of important projects and activities and provide timely updates to the CMD. Ensure effective communication between the CMD and various internal and external stakeholders. Handle urgent assignments and ensure timely execution. 
 3. Communication Correspondence Handle professional phone calls, emails, WhatsApp communication, and other correspondence as required. Draft and format professional emails, letters, reports, and official communications. Communicate with clients, suppliers, vendors, consultants, and business associates professionally. Maintain a high level of professionalism and confidentiality in all communications. 
 4. Meeting Business Support Attend important meetings with the CMD whenever required. Take notes/minutes of meetings and prepare action points. Follow up with relevant personnel to ensure that agreed action items are completed. Assist in preparing presentations, business reports, MIS, and management summaries. Support the CMD in business reviews, planning, and other management activities. 
 5. Travel Event Coordination Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including flights, hotels, transportation, and itineraries, when required. Assist with scheduling business meetings and appointments during travel. Coordinate conferences, business events, meetings, and official engagements. Ensure all travel and meeting-related requirements are arranged in advance. 
 6. Confidentiality Professional Conduct 
 Handle confidential business, financial, operational, and personal information with complete discretion. Maintain strict confidentiality regarding the CMD s discussions, meetings, plans, and business matters. Demonstrate maturity, reliability, integrity, and professional conduct at all times. Maintain appropriate professional boundaries and represent the CMD and company in a professional manner. Required Skills Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong command of English and Hindi. Excellent follow-up and coordination skills. Strong organizational and time-management abilities. Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and work under pressure. Good knowledge of MS Office - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook/email. Professional email drafting and documentation skills. Good interpersonal and relationship-management skills. Ability to communicate confidently with senior-level executives and external stakeholders. Smart, presentable, disciplined, punctual, and professional personality. Strong attention to detail. Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. Proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility. Willingness to work beyond regular hours whenever business requirements demand. Eligibility Education: Graduate in any discipline. MBA/PGDM or a business-related qualification will be an advantage. Experience: 3-5 years of relevant experience as an Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant, Management Assistant, Executive Secretary, or similar position. Candidates who have previously worked directly with a CMD, MD, CEO, Director, or senior management will be preferred. Candidates based in Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi, or Ghaziabad will be preferred. Immediate joiners or candidates serving a short notice period will be given preference. Ideal Candidate 
 We are looking for someone who is: 
 Professional | Trustworthy | Smart | Well-Groomed | Proactive | Disciplined | Confidential | Excellent at Follow-Ups | Strong Communicator 
 The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and should be capable of independently managing responsibilities while keeping the CMD appropriately updated. 
 Job Details:

 Salary: Competitive salary as per candidate s experience, skills, and suitability for the role.

description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Come Join Our Software Integration Team!! Our main activity consists in setting up GE Vernova software in different environments for internal and external customers, supporting project activities and providing expertise in tailoring the components based on requirements. We have a hybrid work environment as we work from home, the office and travel to customer sites as needed. The integration engineer is a key member in all projects, being engaged throughout the full lifecycle (Development, Factory Acceptance Tests, Site Acceptance Tests, Cutover, Support).
   

  

**Job Description**
 GE Vernova allows us to bring a significant contribution to the Worldwide Electrical Energy context. Delivering on life\-critical solutions we are deeply immersed into the worlds of Transmission, Distribution, Asset Management and Market Management making sure we shape how the energy landscape looks today and tomorrow.
   

  

 Our teams breathe software\-life into R\&D, Services and Support for GE Vernova Electrification Software’s products while liaising with stakeholders and customers all around the globe.
   

  

 GE Vernova is a global provider of software, hardware, services, and expertise in automation and embedded computing. We offer a unique foundation of agile and reliable technology providing customers a sustainable competitive advantage in the industries they serve, including energy, water, consumer packaged goods, oil \& gas, government \& defense, and telecommunications.
   

  

 The activity within this office consists of development and implementation of:
   

  

* Energy Management Systems (EMS)
* Distribution Management Systems (DMS)


 Different specialized teams for distinct technical fields contribute to the realization of these systems. (hardware, communications, databases, HMI, applications).
   

  

 One of the activities, carried out in the mentioned context, is engineering for specific monitoring and control of power systems applications (power flow, short\-circuit calculation state estimator, contingency analysis, optimization in power systems, voltage control, load frequency control, power reserve management, load forecast, stability analysis, transient regimes, modeling of the equipment, of the automation and protection systems in power plants and of the power grids, energy market models).
   

  

**Main Job Responsibilities**
* Development of the mathematical models of the physical phenomena in the power systems
* Software development for real\-time applications (code, testing)
* Carrying out the analysis to define the specifications for the real time monitoring and control systems
* Commissioning of the EMS, DMS systems
* Engineering and code development for the EMS, DMS systems that meets the high standards.
* Parameterization, optimization, testing of EMS, DMS systems
* Databases management
* Good technical background is required. The development of professional skills is achieved, in time, by involvement in the team activities and by trainings.
* Knowledge of the power systems phenomena and processes and related mathematical models (power flow, state estimator, short\-circuit analysis, contingency analyst, voltage control, load\-frequency control, power systems optimal regimes, load forecast, stability analysis, transient analysis, modeling of equipment and of automation and protection systems in power plants and power grids, DTS, models for the energy market)
* C / C \+\+ programmer skills or similar
* Exposure in Modelling of SCADA and Power System Analyst Applications
* Familiarity or development experience on Windows OS or UNIX OS


**Qualifications / Requirements**
* Master's degree in Power Systems with 2 to 5 years of experience in the PSA Domain
* Troubleshooting skills
* Fluent in English
* Ability and willingness to travel


 Desired Characteristics
   

  

* Technically good performer who can integrate and test complex software systems to completion with a minimal supervision
* Excellent communication skills (verbal and written)
* Rigorous, methodical, well organized and self\-disciplined
* Take initiatives, good trouble\-shooter and autonomous
* Adaptability, reactivity and Availability
* Ability to analyze complex topics and make a verbal/written synthesis
* Ability and willingness to travel


 Network \& Links
   

  

* Internal: Operations, Product Development, Tendering, and Maintenance \& Support
* External: Customers, Partners


 Performance Measurement
   

  

* On Time Delivery
* Costs deviation \+ Committed budget (effort) deviation
* Software Delivery Processes Compliance
* Customer Satisfaction


 In collaboration with Methods \& Tools
   

  

* Drive excellence in execution through continuous improvement and change management to implement competitiveness improvement initiatives (costs base reduction, lead time reduction, DevOps framework, productivity improvement, quality improvement…)
* Monitor the efforts performance measurement indicators


 In collaboration with Maintenance \& Support
   

  

* Ensure a smooth transfer to maintenance of ending projects through coordinated knowledge transfer.
* Can be solicited to provide some back\-end support to maintenance team as part of the maintenance contract


 Customer Management
   

  

* Comply and contribute to elaboration of relevant Quality Procedures, work instructions and Processes in Quality Management System
* Report or resolve any process non\-conformances in a timely manner


 Health and Safety
   

  

* Sets the example by demonstrating the proper acts and actively observes work conditions.
* Routinely observes routines and behaviors of others and provides immediate feedback regarding unsafe behavior and celebrates achievements or safe behaviors.
* Actively and routinely promotes the identification of hazards and near misses.


******Additional Information******

title: Business Head | Pricious Metals  & Base Metal
description:
Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .
 Key Requirements: 
 B.E. / B.Tech. in Engineering ; M.Tech. or MBA preferred. 
 15+ Years of exp in Metal Sourcing ( Global Sourcing)
 Proven track record of managing end-to-end operations, P&L, and business performance .
 Excellent leadership, analytical, and team management skills.

title: Business Head | Pricious Metals  & Base Metal
description:
Role Overview: 
 We are looking for a dynamic and technically strong Business Head (Metal) to lead the Precious metal business. 
 Must be strong 
 The role involves full business ownership into operations, and sales , with accountability for profitability and growth. The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, Metal Sales along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Business Head Metals & Chemical Processing The role involves end-to-end business ownership , with accountability for plant operations, feed sourcing, sales, profitability, and business growth . The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of chemical processing, metal extraction and sales , along with proven experience in managing large-scale process plants and commercial operations. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Business & P&L Ownership Lead the overall business for metals including Copper, Zinc, Lithium, Cobalt, and Nickel , with end-to-end accountability for business performance and profitability. Formulate and execute business strategies aligned with organizational growth objectives. Drive profitability through cost optimization, process efficiency, capacity utilization, yield improvement, and product realization . Own annual operating budgets, financial performance, working capital, and overall commercial outcomes. Identify opportunities for capacity expansion, new products, process improvements, and value-added downstream businesses. 
 2. Plant Operations & Manufacturing Provide overall leadership to plant operations , ensuring safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective functioning of the manufacturing facility. Drive plant performance across production, yield, recovery, quality, throughput, energy consumption, and operating costs . Ensure optimal utilization of installed capacity and continuously improve operational efficiency. Work closely with plant, process, maintenance, quality, EHS, and technical teams to achieve production and business targets. Establish and monitor operational KPIs and drive a culture of continuous improvement, productivity, and operational excellence . Ensure compliance with all applicable EHS, statutory, environmental, quality, and operational standards . 
 3. Feed Sourcing & Raw Material Strategy Own the end-to-end sourcing strategy for feed/raw materials required for the plant, ensuring adequate availability, quality, and competitive landed cost. Develop and maintain a strong network of feed suppliers, recyclers, aggregators, traders, and strategic sourcing partners . Identify new feed sources and geographies to ensure security and diversification of raw material supply. Lead commercial negotiations, supplier development, contract structuring, and long-term sourcing arrangements. Optimize the feed mix based on plant capabilities, metal recovery, processing economics, quality parameters, and market conditions. Work closely with technical and plant teams to evaluate the metallurgical/chemical suitability and economics of different feed materials . Ensure uninterrupted feed availability while optimizing inventory, working capital, logistics, and overall sourcing costs. 
 4. Sales & Business Development Develop and execute the sales strategy for extracted metals and value-added chemical intermediates . Build and manage relationships with key customers, strategic accounts, traders, and downstream consumers. Formulate commercial strategies covering pricing, customer engagement, contract negotiation, product positioning, and market development . Identify new markets and business opportunities to maximize product realization and margins. Develop long-term customer relationships and strategic partnerships to strengthen market positioning. Monitor metal and chemical market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and demand-supply dynamics to inform business decisions. 
 5. Integrated Commercial & Operational Management Balance feed economics, plant performance, metal recovery, product realization, and market pricing to maximize overall business profitability. Develop an integrated view of the business from feed sourcing plant processing metal recovery product sales cash realization . Ensure close coordination between sourcing, operations, sales, finance, and supply chain teams. Take data-driven decisions on feed procurement, production planning, inventory, product mix, and sales allocation. 
 6. Leadership & Team Management Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams across operations, sourcing, sales, commercial, and support functions . Establish clear performance metrics and accountability across the organization. Work closely with senior management/promoters on strategic decisions, investments, expansion plans, and overall business growth. Drive a strong culture of ownership, operational discipline, commercial excellence, and profitability .
 Key Requirements: 
 B.E. / B.Tech. in Engineering ; M.Tech. or MBA preferred. 
 15+ Years of exp in Metal Sourcing ( Global Sourcing)
 Proven track record of managing end-to-end operations, P&L, and business performance .
 Excellent leadership, analytical, and team management skills.

Key Skills: Plant Operations,PNL Management,Battery Minerals,Business Operations,precious metal,Business Strategy,Profitability,Production Improvement
